limits: Recovered British and U.S. reforms only.
entries.wave_01_claim: Merit systems in the seed begin as authentic anti-corruption technologies rather than as a sham invented only to exclude.

limits: Definitional transfer is an inference; authorship, thresholds, and access remain open.
entries.wave_01_claim: Replacing patron discretion with an examination transfers consequential definitional authority to the institution that authors and administers merit.

limits: No equivalence or universal neutrality finding.
entries.wave_01_claim: The seed does not support treating every examination, merit system, or passing result as equivalent.

limits: Historical texts only; no universal modern ontology.
entries.wave_01_claim: Industrial selection changed the institutional question from fair public appointment toward managerial placement and output.

limits: The welfare-work/personnel-management split was not independently adjudicated in this wave.
entries.wave_01_claim: The care/control split gives HR a dual vocabulary while the controlling branch retains classification, risk, and throughput authority.

limits: No universal personnel-system ontology.
entries.wave_01_claim: The seed cannot establish one universal management-authored job ontology across all personnel systems.

limits: Operating pattern, not uninterrupted lineage.
entries.wave_01_claim: War normalized high-volume classification before deep individual understanding as an acceptable institutional operating mode.

limits: Historical setting only.
entries.wave_01_claim: A score can become socially consequential even while the relationship between the measured construct and operational performance remains contested.

limits: Instrument migration and construct identity remain open.
entries.wave_01_claim: The seed does not support a single uninterrupted technical lineage from every Army test to every modern HR instrument.

limits: Method distinction, not employer-specific validity.
entries.wave_01_claim: Behavioral simulations, personality inventories, aptitude tests, and instruction-following exercises sample different evaluative objects.

limits: Legal correction supported; novelty loss and individual false negatives remain separate.
entries.wave_01_claim: Civil-rights law created a genuine job-relevance and adverse-impact correction without solving every individual false-negative or novelty-loss problem.

limits: No employer record, scores, accommodation disposition, or jurisdiction-specific legal analysis.
entries.wave_01_claim: The seed cannot establish a legal conclusion about Agoda, a missing score, or the disposition of the accommodation request.

limits: Compression history does not invalidate every framework.
entries.wave_01_claim: A reform aimed at contextual competence can be compressed into standardized traits and sold as portable person-job fit.

limits: Report-level funnel analysis; no universal employer objective.
entries.wave_01_claim: Internet recruiting made disposal throughput a first-order operating objective, creating strong incentives for cheap, comparable, defensible signals.

limits: Exact responsibility division must be recovered per deployment.
entries.wave_01_claim: Distributed vendor-employer authorship can make an adverse exertion appear ownerless unless role, instrument, threshold, and final judgment are joined.

limits: Magnitude and direction remain policy- and label-specific.
entries.wave_01_claim: Learning from selected survivors is selection-conditioned learning, not neutral observation of the full applicant population.

limits: Full causal pathway requires deployment-specific label and opportunity custody.
entries.wave_01_claim: Institutional resemblance can be reported as prediction when labels encode prior selection, opportunity allocation, ratings, and sponsorship.

limits: Studied vendor ecosystem and recommendations only.
entries.wave_01_claim: Shared-vendor screening creates a plausible cross-employer monoculture risk rather than guaranteeing independent market correction.

limits: Interface literacy is synthesis; no universal or individual ranking.
entries.wave_01_claim: Privilege in the seed includes interface literacy: knowing how corporate questions, credentials, demeanor, and trait language are coded.

limits: Bounded mechanisms in studied venues.
entries.wave_01_claim: Selection can become self-validating when insiders receive the opportunities that generate performance evidence and later author the next selector.

limits: No individual moral ranking; not all persona management is deception.
entries.wave_01_claim: The seed does not support an individual moral ranking of successful applicants or a claim that all persona management is deception.

limits: The private case and systems work sample are not published or independently recovered in this wave.
entries.wave_01_claim: The case supports a dimensional-loss question: a long standardized battery and an unsolicited systems work sample observed different objects.

limits: Scores, causal rule, accommodation disposition, legality, and counterfactual outcome remain unknown.
entries.wave_01_claim: The exact cause of rejection, accommodation disposition, score profile, legal status, and counterfactual hiring outcome remain blocked.

limits: Protocol is a proposed control object, not current law or adopted project policy.
entries.wave_01_claim: Clifford Number can convert the unresolved burden into a decision-receipt specification that keeps the prediction attached to its authors.

promotion_rule: Wave 02 may record independent support and limits but may not rewrite Wave 01, promote a seed finding into canonical authority, or close private, legal, universal, or employer-specific questions.
